source.title: To Young Political Workers

passages.excerpt_preview: He opposed communalism and asked young people to develop a scientific, critical outlook.
He urged study, organization, work among peasants and workers, and warned against individual heroics substituting for a disciplined mass movement.
He defined it as overthrow of an unjust existing social order and its replacement by a socialist order.

passages.locator: did not mean bombs and pistols alone
passages.excerpt_preview: n February 1931 Bhagat Singh told young political workers that revolution did not mean bombs and pistols alone.
